name: Tiny Shakespeare
source: karpathy/char-rnn (GitHub mirror of Shakespeare's complete works)
notes: First NICS Text dataset: small (~1.1MB), unambiguously licensed, used to validate the from-scratch tokenizer + training pipeline end to end (nics-text-nano). Not intended to produce a broadly capable model on its own.

name: Fashion-MNIST
copyright_risk: none -- images are Zalando's own product catalog photographs, MIT-licensed by the copyright holder (not a third-party scrape)
notes: 10-class grayscale clothing image classification dataset, 28x28px, 60,000 train / 10,000 test images. Used to train nics-vision-nano end to end. checksum_sha256 and size_bytes are per-file (4 idx-ubyte.gz files); size_bytes total is the sum of all four.

source_url: n8n workflow [41 LAB] Market Data Export (private, key-protected, read-only)

permitted_use: internal training and evaluation; not redistributed

copyright_risk: low -- own records; raw broker data is not republished

name: Public D1/W1 market history
source: Kraken public OHLC API (BTC/USD, ETH/USD); Yahoo Finance chart API (indices, gold/silver/Brent futures, US stocks, FX; USD/CNH via onshore CNY=X)
license: Third-party public market data; Yahoo terms do not permit redistribution. Used for internal research/training only, nothing republished.
permitted_use: internal training and evaluation; not redistributed
commercial_use: unclear -- review before shipping a model trained with it commercially, or train with --no-public
copyright_risk: medium -- third-party terms; raw data is never republished
notes: Not our broker's prices (futures vs spot, index vs CFD). Features are scale-free (ATR units), so the model learns market shape from them. Every row keeps its source. Added on Alexander's request (2026-11-18) to train on all available public data we use.

name: Public H1/H4 market history (Dukascopy)
source: Dukascopy historical data feed, monthly hourly candle files (FX, XAU, XAG, Brent, indices, BTC)
version: 1 (per snapshot: rows with source public:dukascopy:* in public_candles.csv)
license: Third-party public market data. Used for internal research/training only, nothing republished.
permitted_use: internal training and evaluation; not redistributed
commercial_use: unclear -- review before shipping a model trained with it commercially, or train with --no-public
copyright_risk: medium -- third-party terms; raw data is never republished
notes: Since 2008. High/low columns and price scale detected from the data and checked against our broker close (15 % tolerance). Methodology setups on this history are training-only. Downloads are paced (~1 request/s), cached, and stop for the night after repeated 429/503.

name: Our closed MT5 positions
source: MetaTrader 5 terminal trade history of our accounts (prop, Vantage, algo), read locally with the official MetaTrader5 Python package
permitted_use: internal training and evaluation; not redistributed
personal_data_risk: low -- account number not stored; account label only
notes: Positions without SL and TP at open are kept in the file but cannot become labelled setups.

name: Smithsonian NMNH Department of Mineral Sciences, Open Access images
source: Smithsonian Open Access bulk metadata (public S3 bucket smithsonian-open-access, unit nmnhminsci)
license: CC0 1.0 (only images whose usage.access is CC0 are kept, checked per image)
copyright_risk: none -- CC0 dedication by the Smithsonian Institution
notes: 28,734 CC0 images on 2026-11-22, 27,202 mapped to a NICS Vision Geo class (22,388 of them meteorite photos, capped per class and per specimen at build time). Museum photographs: clean specimens on plain backgrounds, unlike field photos. Metadata is read into data/geo/manifest.jsonl (one row per image with licence, attribution, record link, specimen id); images are downloaded and re-encoded at 192 px without EXIF into data/geo/cache. Checksums: sha256 of the manifest per fetch (below) and of every cached image in the build summary.

name: Natural History Museum London, mineralogy collection specimens with images
source: NHM Data Portal, collection specimens resource, collectionCode MIN, records with images
license: CC BY 4.0 per image (checked per image; attribution to creator and The Trustees of the Natural History Museum, London kept per row)
copyright_risk: low -- CC BY 4.0 issued by the rights holder; attribution must be kept
notes: 5,038 images on 2026-11-22, 3,198 mapped to a class. Mostly rocks (a large decorative/building stone set: marble, limestone, sandstone, granite); containers, slides and analysis samples are filtered out by name. Metadata is read into data/geo/manifest.jsonl (one row per image with licence, attribution, record link, specimen id); images are downloaded and re-encoded at 192 px without EXIF into data/geo/cache. Checksums: sha256 of the manifest per fetch (below) and of every cached image in the build summary.

name: Wikimedia Commons rock and mineral photos (planned, laptop)
source: Wikimedia Commons API, files directly in the categories listed per class in src/nics/geo/taxonomy.py
license: per file from extmetadata: CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA kept; NC/ND and unknown refused. CC BY-SA rows are flagged and can be excluded with data.exclude_share_alike
personal_data_risk: low -- some photos may show people; to be reviewed before a model ships
copyright_risk: medium -- licences are stated by uploaders; per-file attribution kept; share-alike scope for model weights to be confirmed by counsel
notes: Not fetched yet: on 2026-11-22 the cloud egress got HTTP 429 from Commons on the first request. The reader is unit-tested on recorded responses; first live run planned from the laptop (scripts/geo_fetch.py --sources commons).
